instruction: Approve all venmo payment requests from my roommates from this calendar month.
notes: Roommates are discovered via phone.search_contacts(relationship='roommate'); the pending received Venmo requests via venmo.show_received_payment_requests(status='pending'). Facts in :init such as (roommate ?p), (request-from ?r ?p) and (request-this-month ?r) are world state, not agent knowledge; knowledge is gated by the nullary predicates (roommates-known) and (requests-known) asserted by the two lookup actions. Approval is restricted to pending requests from roommates created in the current month (June 2023), so distractor requests pr-4 (roommate, previous month) and pr-5 (non-roommate, this month) are never touched, matching the evaluation that only the target requests change (approved_at only). The reference solution approves three requests, so the problem instantiates three targets and supervisor-complete-task takes three distinct approved request records as (non-API) parameters so its precondition mirrors the goal; the task asks no question, so complete_task is called without an answer.
